No synthesized journal fact, reminders, future task insert, Edge, scheduled jobs, staging, first-aid or migration 024 changes. T160/T171 remain open.

Add pgTAP coverage in the existing fixture. Check initial watering-derived date, exact replay after advance, a second valid completion, newer/backdated watering, revoked source or disabled/expired access, retained older history and no duplicates.
